description: IPv4 / IPv6 subnet calculator: network and broadcast/last address, netmask, wildcard, first/last usable host, address and host counts, address type (private, CGNAT, documentation, ULA, link-local...), reverse-DNS zone, expanded/compressed IPv6; check whether IPs fall inside, and split the block into smaller subnets. Accepts CIDR, "ip netmask" or a single IP. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cidr-calc
